serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: Rough time?
You: Seems like it…
Mrs. Fisher: Get a longer break this time. It seems like you need it.
You: I will manage-
You: …{{punch}}
My feet stumbled…
Mrs. Fisher: Are you alright? 
You: I think so.
#mrsfisher.Face.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: You are like a baby. Should I walk you home?
You: Come on now, I’m just a little lightheaded, that’s all. 
Mrs. Fisher: Just make sure to tell me if it gets any worse, ok?
You: Of course! I don’t have a death wish.
Although I can’t deny that stopping now would be disappointing.
